items.headline: NovaTek raises data-centre guidance
items.body: NovaTek Semiconductor raised its data-centre outlook after strong hyperscaler demand.

items.headline: Meridian Bio phase III trial misses primary endpoint
items.body: Meridian Bio shares fell 22% after its lead candidate failed its phase III readout.

items.headline: ACME signs repricing deal with largest customer
